02 / SELECTED WORK

Recent case studies

Real systems, currently in use by real schools.

Microsoft 365 · Power Automate

Digital Operations Hub

A paperless digital operations hub built entirely on Microsoft 365 — not a single commercial platform. Forms collect requests, SharePoint Lists store and organize the data, Power Automate runs the approval workflows, Outlook handles sign-off, and Power BI reports the results.

Purchase orders Leave requests Incident reports HR inquiries Security & transport Facilities & maintenance
OUTCOME

Every one of these requests used to move on paper or in someone's inbox. They now run through one tracked, auditable workflow — no separate platform license, no department left on its own spreadsheet.

Odoo ERP

School ERP Rollout — Qatar

A full Odoo implementation unifying a school's back office: CRM, accounting, purchasing, events, contacts, and the public website, all running from one connected system instead of scattered spreadsheets and standalone tools.

CRM Accounting Purchasing Events Website Dashboards
OUTCOME

The back office moved off scattered spreadsheets and standalone tools onto one connected system — every department working from the same live data instead of reconciling separate files.

Power Automate · SharePoint

Admissions-to-Enrollment Automation — Saudi Arabia

An end-to-end Power Automate flow that runs the entire admissions journey with zero manual data entry — from the moment a family submits an inquiry through to final enrollment. The flow auto-routes new inquiries, automatically sends staged email notifications at every step (visit booking, assessment invite, results, payment confirmation, enrollment), and generates auto-marked placement exam results. Every update writes back to SharePoint in real time, where the data feeds live analysis — enrollment funnel tracking, applicant demographics, and feeder-school sources — giving administrators one auditable source of truth and a working analytics view for each applicant's status. Built for a school in Saudi Arabia, it replaced a fully manual, spreadsheet-driven process with a self-running, self-reporting pipeline.

Zero manual entry Staged notifications Auto-marked exams Real-time SharePoint sync Enrollment funnel analytics Feeder-school sources
OUTCOME

Admissions staff stopped re-typing applicant data between a form, a spreadsheet, and their inbox. One submission now drives the entire journey automatically, with a live, auditable view of every applicant's status.
